question: In the freeway or expressway lane-ends sequence in Figure 2C-13, which symbol sign is shown nearest the beginning of the lane-reduction taper?
model_answer: Direct Answer: In the freeway/expressway lane-ends sequence (Panel A, Sheet 1 of 5 of Figure 2C-13), the symbol sign shown nearest the beginning of the lane-reduction taper is the Lane Ends (W4-2R) symbol sign, placed at the advance placement distance from Table 2C-3. The word-legend RIGHT LANE ENDS (W9-1R) sign with the 1000 FEET (W16-2P) plaque is shown farther upstream as an optional supplement. Guidance (recommended): - "The Lane Ends (W4-2) sign should be installed at the advance placement distance in accordance with Table 2C-3." Options (permitted): - The figure labels the upstream RIGHT LANE ENDS (W9-1R) sign as "(optional)," accompanied by the W16-2P distance plaque; additionally, "Where a lane ends a distance beyond the intersection that is less than the advance placement distance indicated in Table 2C-3, the W4-2 sign may be located at the far side of the intersection (see Sheet 4 of Figure 2C-13)." Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Sheet 1 of Figure 2C-13 ("A – Freeway or expressway - lane ends") shows the W4-2R symbol sign as the sign closest to the start of the right-lane taper, with the dimension line for the Table 2C-3 advance placement distance measured from it, and the W9-1R (optional) with W16-2P plaque located farther upstream. - [Image 2] The full-page view of page 185 confirms the same sequence: W4-2R nearest the taper, W9-1R (optional)/W16-2P 1000 FEET upstream. - [Image 3] Sheet 5 of Figure 2C-13 shows a different condition (two lanes merging to one) using the W4-8 sign, not the freeway lane-ends sequence. - [Image 4] Figure 3B-14 (lane-reduction transition markings) similarly depicts the W4-2R sign at the advance placement distance nearest the taper, with W9-1R (optional) upstream. - [Image 5] Sheet 3 of Figure 2C-13 shows the left-lane-ends versions (W4-2L, W9-1L), consistent with the W4-2 sign being nearest the taper. Citations: - Section 2C.47 Support §2 (p.183) - Section 2C.47 Support §1 (p.183) - Section 2C.47 Guidance §3 (p.186) - Section 2C.47 Option §7 (p.186) - Figure 2C-13 (p.185) - Page 226 - Page 608
gold_answer: The W4-2R Lane Ends symbol sign.
